The '''52nd [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''', given in 2000, honored the film and television best writers of 1999.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2005-1996 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260217142826/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |archive-date=2026-02-17 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2000/1/|title=Writers Guild of America, USA (2000)|website=IMDb|access-date=2026-02-20}}</ref>


==Film==
===Best Adapted Screenplay===
''' ''[[Election (1999 film)|Election]]'' - [[Alexander Payne]] and [[Jim Taylor (writer)|Jim Taylor]]'''
*''[[The Cider House Rules]]'' - [[John Irving]] † 
*''[[The Insider (film)|The Insider]]'' - [[Michael Mann]] and [[Eric Roth]]
*''[[October Sky]]'' - [[Lewis Colick]]
*''[[The Talented Mr. Ripley (film)|The Talented Mr. Ripley]]'' - [[Anthony Minghella]]

===Best Original Screenplay===
''' ''[[American Beauty (1999 film)|American Beauty]]'' - [[Alan Ball (screenwriter)|Alan Ball]]''' † 
*''[[Being John Malkovich]]'' - [[Charlie Kaufman]]
*''[[Magnolia (film)|Magnolia]]'' - [[Paul Thomas Anderson]]
*''[[The Sixth Sense]]'' - [[M. Night Shyamalan]]
*''[[Three Kings (1999 film)|Three Kings]]'' - [[John Ridley]] and [[David O. Russell]]

==Television==
===Best Episodic Comedy===
''' ''[[Merry Christmas, Mrs. Moskowitz]]'' - [[Frasier]] - [[Jay Kogen]]'''
*''[[The Paper Hat Anniversary]]'' - [[Dharma & Greg]] - [[Bill Prady]], [[Eric Zicklin]] and [[Chuck Lorre]]
*''[[The One Where Everybody Finds Out]]'' - [[Friends]] - [[Alexa Junge]]
*''[[Four Women and A Hobo]]'' - [[Sex and The City]] - [[Jenny Bicks]]
*''Evolution'' - [[Sex and The City]] - [[Cindy Chupack]]

===Best Episodic Drama===
''' ''[[Meadowlands (The Sopranos episode)|Meadowlands]]'' - [[The Sopranos]] - [[Jason Cahill]]'''
*''[[The Storm, Part 1]]'' - [[ER (TV series)|ER]] - [[John Wells (TV producer)|John Wells]]
*''[[DWB (Law & Order)|DWB]]'' - [[Law & Order]] - [[René Balcer]]
*''[[U.S. Male]]'' - [[Oz (TV series)|Oz]] - [[Tom Fontana]] and [[Bradford Winters]]

===Original Long Form===
''' ''[[Dash and Lily]]'' - [[Jerrold L. Ludwig]]'''
*''[[Freak City (film)|Freak City]]''  - [[Jane Shepard]]
*''[[Aldrich Ames: Traitor Within]]'' - [[Michael Burton (screenwriter)|Michael Burton]]
*''[[Purgatory]]'' - [[Gordon T. Dawson]]
